text:
amanda: morning async — quick standup. what I did: landed the prewarm hook for model-y, validated prefix cache priming in staging. blockers: eu-west1 h100 quota bump still PENDING (ticket #3456). today: follow up with cloud-ops and start a small canary to dedicated pool if we get headroom.

kevin: saw the ticket, just pinged cloud-ops (cc @amanda). they said request is 'in review' with AWS, ETA ~6h. can we temporarily route eu requests to a100 until h100 quota clears?

priya: quick numbers from the headroom probe (just ran): us-west2: 18 a100 free, eu-west1: 2 h100 free, ap-southeast-1: 5 t4 free. spot eviction risk high in ap-southeast-1 this morning.

infra-bot: automated capacity snapshot 2026-03-18T07:40Z — eu-west1 total GPUs: 40 (h100:10, a100:20, t4:10). current utilization 75%.

kevin: proposed change — fallback routing rule for eu-west1: prefer h100, fallback to a100 if headroom <4. canary 10% for 30m. I pushed a quick patch to routing-config, see PR: #987.

amanda: +1 on fallback. i'll enable the canary at 08:00 UTC for 30m and watch latency/cost. also will review PR #987 in 30m.

priya: if quota not granted by 14:00 UTC i'll file a short reserved-pool request for 6 h100 for 24h to cover the ramp. that should avoid cascading prewarm failures.

kevin: for visibility, reproduce check command I used:
```
./scripts/check_headroom.sh --region eu-west1 --gpu h100 --json
# returns: {"free":2, "reserved":6, "pending_requests":1}
```

amanda: thanks. action items: (1) @kevin enable canary fallback at 08:00 UTC, (2) @priya open reserved pool if quota not approved by 14:00 UTC, (3) @amanda review PR #987 and follow up on ticket #3456.

priya: noted. i'll also add a short note to the runbook about the ap-southeast spot risk. :memo:

kevin: pinging @cloud-ops as well, leaving a follow-up in the ticket. :thumbsup:

amanda: done, will post a short postmortem note if canary shows regressions.

kevin: ack.

infra-bot: deploy-check: routing-config canary scheduled for 2026-03-18T08:00:00Z — status: scheduled.
